About the Scholarship

MOPGA (Make Our Planet Great Again) is France's research programme attracting international scientists to work on climate, earth sciences and the energy transition through doctoral and postdoctoral funding hosted at French institutions. Campus France publishes each year's call — including the application window and eligibility — on the MOPGA page.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

MOPGA (Make Our Planet Great Again) is France's research programme attracting international scientists to work on climate, earth sciences and the energy transition through doctoral and postdoctoral funding hosted at French institutions. Campus France publishes each year's call — including the application window and eligibility — on the MOPGA page.

Programme Highlights

  • Flagship French programme for climate and energy-transition researchers
  • Doctoral and postdoctoral tracks hosted at leading French institutions
  • Call-specific deadlines announced annually by Campus France
  • Strong integration into French research networks (CNRS, universities, national agencies)

Who Should Apply

Researchers worldwide with projects aligned to climate science, earth system research and energy transition themes at the doctoral or postdoctoral level.

Funding and Costs

MOPGA doctoral contracts and postdoc positions with competitive salaries, per the call conditions each year.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the Campus France MOPGA page for the 2027 call announcement and follow the two-step application described there. Key deadline information: Annual call for the 2027 intake — dates announced by Campus France on the MOPGA page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Campus France

Campus France is the French national agency for international higher education and mobility, operating under the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. It administers France's major international scholarship programmes, including the France Excellence Eiffel scholarship, and guides international students through admission to French universities and grandes ecoles.

Official website: https://www.campusfrance.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual call - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
